Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.

If the IGEA-PRIM 5t overhead travelling crane at position 13 were used under regular conditions, i.e. outside the construction, steel, port and extractive sectors, how often would it have to be verified in 2031?

response.text: In 2031, how frequently would the IGEA-PRIM 5t overhead travelling crane at position 13 need to be inspected if it were operated under ordinary conditions, meaning outside the construction, steel, port and extractive sectors?
